== pending policy effects (not emitted)
  Tradition: Palace +3 culture (BuildingClassCultureChanges) is approximated by the opener's capital culture
  B031 retune: Monarchy (CapitalYieldPerPopChanges gold 50 = +1 Gold per 2 citizens, CapitalUnhappinessMod -50), Meritocracy (HappinessPerTradeRoute 100 = +1 Happiness per international route, replacing the G&K connected-cities happiness), Warrior Code (GreatGeneralRateModifier 50) and Sovereignty (+1 Gold from the five science buildings) were retuned; Aristocracy, Representation, Citizenship, Collective Rule, Discipline, Military Caste, Mandate of Heaven, Theocracy and Free Thought already match the BNW columns
  Reformation: AddReformationBelief grants one free Reformation belief once a religion is founded (B022). Religious Tolerance: SecondReligionPantheon grants one free Pantheon belief (B022)
  Consulates: MinorFriendshipMinimum 20 is read as the G&K 'resting point' unique. Merchant Confederacy: CityStateTradeChange 200 is read as +2 Gold per city-state route (B020 settles the scale)
  Patronage Complete: allied city-states gifting Great People reuses the G&K wording (MinorGreatPeopleAllies)
  Mercenary Army: no stat column; it only unlocks the Landsknecht unit (not in the generated units yet) and is a prerequisite of Mercantilism
  Wagon Trains: RouteGoldMaintenanceMod -50 is read as road/rail maintenance; Entrepreneurship: EmbarkedExtraMoves 1 has no unique yet
  Scientific Revolution: MedianTechPercentChange 25 (one-shot) has no unique yet; Rationalism Complete keeps the G&K free-tech wording with the BNW count (1)
  Exploration Complete: reveals Hidden Antiquity Sites through the resource's revealedBy (B040); Aesthetics Complete has no leader title
  Exploration opener: PROMOTION_NAVAL_TRADITION is MovesChange 1 and VisibilityChange 1 on the naval combat classes (UnitPromotions.tsv), so +1 Movement and +1 Sight for naval units is confirmed [K]. Meritocracy's route happiness is counted per international route the city owns (origin side), the same rule as Messenger of the Gods
  Cultural Exchange: ethics tourism modifiers are declared data only (B030)
  B030 tenets without a unique: Resettlement (NewCityExtraPopulation 3), United Front (CityStateUnitFrequencyModifier 100) and Clausewitz's Legacy (a one-shot 50-turn attack bonus, strength unknown [?]) have no declared unique yet. B023: Patriotic War (Nationalism +15% in friendly lands), Lightning Warfare (a free promotion on new Armored units, Fast General +3 Movement for Great Generals) and Elite Forces (WoundedUnitDamageMod -25 is approximated by removing the wounded-unit damage penalty) are declared. Volunteer Army's six free Foreign Legion units are six 'Free [unit] appears' uniques; Iron Curtain's free Courthouse and the city-state, espionage, spaceship and purchase-cost rows are declared data only
  B030 scales [I]: Economic Union reads SharedIdeologyTradeGoldChange 3 as +3 whole Gold per route (the city-state row is whole Gold too), Treaty Organization reads ProtectedMinorPerTurnInfluence 400 as +4 and Gunboat Diplomacy AfraidMinorPerTurnInfluence 600 as +6 (hundredths); Iron Curtain's InternalTradeRouteYieldModifier 50 applies to Food and Production routes
